import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static String solve, s;
    static int N;

    static void Check() {
        if (solve.charAt(0) == '.') {
            solve = "dot" + solve.substring(1);
        } else if (solve.charAt(0) == '@') {
            solve = "at" + solve.substring(1);
        }

        int len = solve.length();
        if (solve.charAt(len - 1) == '.') {
            solve = solve.substring(0, len - 1) + "dot";
        } else if (solve.charAt(len - 1) == '@') {
            solve = solve.substring(0, len - 1) + "at";
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        s = sc.nextLine();

        N = s.length();
        solve = "";

        for (int I = 0; I < N; ++I) {
            if (I + 3 <= N && s.substring(I, I + 3).equals("dot")) {
                solve += ".";
                I += 2;
            } else if (I + 2 <= N && s.substring(I, I + 2).equals("at")) {
                solve += "@";
                I += 1;
            } else {
                solve += s.charAt(I);
            }
        }

        Check();

        int cont = 0;
        for (int I = 0; I < solve.length(); ++I) {
            if (solve.charAt(I) == '@') {
                cont++;
            }
        }

        if (cont == 1) {
            System.out.println(solve);
        } else {
            boolean ok = true;
            StringBuilder output = new StringBuilder();
            for (int I = 0; I < solve.length(); ++I) {
                char ch = solve.charAt(I);
                if (ch == '@') {
                    if (ok) {
                        output.append('@');
                        ok = false;
                    } else {
                        output.append("at");
                    }
                } else {
                    output.append(ch);
                }
            }
            System.out.println(output.toString());
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
